subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw make five role-specific memory selections, including per-agent overrides and hook-level role filtering, a supported long-term core/plugin API now?
rationale: This is a new public configuration and plugin contract with compatibility and session-routing consequences; source review cannot determine the desired permanent product boundary or deprecation policy.

options.title: Sponsor the role-slot contract
options.body: Approve the five-role model as a supported API, with an explicit Doctor migration and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the initial scope
options.body: Limit the change to the smallest independently useful role or migration path, leaving additional roles for follow-up design work.

options.title: Keep composition plugin-owned
options.body: Decline new core role slots and direct complementary memory behavior through existing plugin contracts or external plugin work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the role-slot contract
recommendation.body: Approve the five-role model as a supported API, with an explicit Doctor migration and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available routing signal from the PR’s memory-architecture discussion, although repository-history ownership could not be established here.
